name: Golden Coconut Curry Soup with Turkey Meatballs, Spinach & Mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
3 red bell peppers
0.68 kg white mushrooms
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Place in a large bowl along with turkey, bread crumbs, eggs, and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ground turkey
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
3 eggs
1 ½ tsp turmeric, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into rounded meatballs. Arrange on the baking sheet.
Place meatballs in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning halfway, until golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and roughly chop bell peppers. Place in a clean large bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl with the bell peppers.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the other veggies.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp virgin coconut oil
3 tbsp garam masala
1 tbsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add broth and coconut milk to the pot, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
instructions.secondary_message:
2129 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ (398 ml) cans coconut milk

instructions.primary_message: Add baked meatballs to the pot and stir to combine the soup. Continue to cook until heated through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide the soup between bowls and enjoy!
